summary: Log cabin c.1923 and 30-foot L-4 tower c.1936 in Bonner County; removed or destroyed in 1964; no documented staff.

facts.status_note: Removed or destroyed in 1964; the sources differ on which. No source describes a standing structure.

access.note: On Kaniksu National Forest land. No source says the site is closed. None describes the site today.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site hike-in. No source gives a route.

events.note: Log cabin built about 1923, per the register, firelookout.com and the Weebly page.
Register says removed in 1964. Firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and the Weebly page say destroyed in 1964.

evidence.supports: log cabin about 1923; 30-foot L-4 tower about 1936
evidence.quote: A log cabin was built about 1923, with this 30' pole L-4 tower constructed about 1936.
A log cabin was built about 1923, with this 30' pole L-4 tower constructed about 1936.

evidence.supports: log cabin 1923 and L-4 tower 1936 listed

evidence.quote: We don't yet have a documented staffing history for this lookout.
c.1936: A 30-foot round timber tower with an L-4 cab constructed.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register says removed in 1964. Firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and the Weebly page say destroyed in 1964. The record keeps the 1964 date and reports both words; the story says so.
Register and firelookout.com give 4,392 ft (1,339 m), matching the brief's 1338.7 m. Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 4932 ft, which the other two do not support. The record keeps 1338.7 m.

notes_for_editor: Brief had the 2010 registration but no build or removal events; added the c.1923 cabin, the c.1936 tower and the 1964 event. Height 9.1 m is the 30-foot pole figure (30 ft = 9.14 m). Staffing: no documented history on the Idaho Fire Lookouts page. Access level 'public' rests on Kaniksu National Forest land and the absence of any closure in the sources; no source describes the site today or its remains. The sources disagree on removed versus destroyed in 1964; the story reports both. Idaho Fire Lookouts' 4932 ft elevation looks like an error against two other sources.
